column1: Jake McCarthy leads off for Washington with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable platoon advantage against Jake Irvin, making him a reliable pick to record a hit. Jackson Chourio also offers steady production at the top of Milwaukee’s lineup and benefits from a soft matchup with Sean Manaea. Ernie Clement and Jordan Walker have similar profiles with recent reliability, but McCarthy’s combination of recent form and matchup stands out for Beat The Streak players.
